source: Eli's method, applied to every client until a client's own number replaces it. Edit on the Builder's House defaults page.

rules.rule: Card interest rate used when a card has no APR, or an intro rate has no rate after it
rules.notes: Filled in at load and after each Ledger edit, stored as rough so it shows yellow

rules.rule: Day of the month a debt payment is due when none is entered
rules.appliesTo: Every debt type: credit cards, auto, student, personal and other loans, mortgages, HELOCs, BNPL, IOUs with a payment
rules.notes: Filled in at load and after each Ledger edit, stored as rough. A card statement close day is never filled in.

rules.rule: APY used when a cash account (not high-yield savings) has none
rules.notes: 0.01%, about what a regular checking or savings account pays; filled in at load and after each Ledger edit, stored as rough. High-yield savings is left blank so the real rate is asked for

rules.rule: Monthly cost of a standard phone plan for one line, used when a phone expense has no amount
rules.notes: A single-line unlimited plan at a major carrier with taxes and fees, roughly $65 to $80 in 2026; prepaid plans cost less. For a phone someone else covers, it is what it would cost you. Stored as rough

rules.rule: Yearly change in a vehicle's value when none is entered
rules.notes: A car loses about 15% of its value a year; stored on the car as rough so it shows yellow, and the net worth projection uses it

rules.rule: Default card minimum: this share of the balance plus a month of interest
Default card minimum: never less than this
rules.notes: Stored as a rough default when a card has no minimum; recomputed as the balance changes; never more than the balance

rules.rule: Rule of 5: months of expenses = age divided by this
Housing reference line as a share of take-home, shown beside the DRAFTT housing letter (no verdict)
rules.notes: Answer L002: a reference, not a target or a colour

rules.rule: The Financial Order of Operations, rung by rung
rules.notes: Deductibles covered, the employer match, high-interest debt, emergency reserves (the Rule of 5 target), Roth and HSA room, retirement maxed, hyper-accumulation (a savings rate), prepaid future expenses (goals), low-interest debt. Change the order here, not in code.
rules.source: Eli's default (The Money Guy Financial Order of Operations, as the spec (E007) adopts it)

rules.rule: Hyper-accumulation: the gross savings rate the FOO aims for
rules.source: Eli's default (The Money Guy Financial Order of Operations (25%))

rules.rule: Debt at or above this rate counts as high-interest for the extra at the debt (stopAtHi) and the high-interest-free date
rules.appliesTo: Cash simulation: the extra at the debt

rules.rule: The order a lump sum is assigned in the Windfall room
rules.notes: Tax on the money itself (when it is still owed), the year's tax bill, cash up to the stage 1 floor, promo balances the surplus cannot clear in time, the employer match left on the table this year (answer 23: before the cards, skipped and said so when no stream has a match), cards charging interest now (highest rate first), cash up to the Rule of 5 target, the year's Roth IRA room, then what is left. Change the order here, not in code.

rules.rule: A difference smaller than this is too small to matter: the month reads on plan
A variable expense's latest month is up or down when it is this far from its own average; closer reads steady
Months added to the Rule of 5 cushion when income is only okay
Months added to the Rule of 5 cushion when income is shaky
